{{Sagittarius}}
Sagittarius 3 is the 3rd day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 3rd day of Sagittarius, and it is a Wednesday. It corresponds to ISO week 1, weekday 3.

Its informal Japanese name is 1宮3日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 3|Chapter 3]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152023}}.

[[Category:Dates with custom text]]
===Chapter summary===
Aster nurtures creation with her cosmic milk, weaving the Milky Way and imagining children of starlight to guide her love with Andromeda. A pantheon of stars arises: Juno of gas giants, Brunhilda of failed stars, Ruby the enduring red dwarf, Chrystella of main sequence life and decline, Celestella of red supergiants and pulsars, and Gigastella, whose fiery collapse births a black hole. Together, they embody the cycles of stellar life and cosmic destiny.
